Name: Dia-Log (NPC Dialogue)
Author: HBLRipZ
Description:
[size=4][b]Dia-Log (NPC Dialogue Log) - EXPANSION COMPATIBLE![/b][/size]

Ever clicked through an NPC's dialogue too fast and wished you could read it again? This mod records every line of dialogue spoken to you and lets you review it at any time.

Press [b]L[/b] to open the log. Browse everything you've been told, or click a character's name to filter to just their lines. The log saves with your farm so nothing is ever lost between sessions.

[url=https://ko-fi.com/R5R61YFRFM][img]https://i.ibb.co/sv8c2SjK/kofi6.jpg[/img][/url]

[line]

[size=3][b]Features[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Logs every line of NPC dialogue as it happens[/*]
[*]Filter by character using the buttons at the top[/*]
[*]Scrollable list, newest entries first[/*]
[*]Persists across sessions - saved per farm file[/*]
[*]Works at any window size or resolution, including while resizing[/*]
[*]Multiplayer friendly - each player logs their own dialogue[/*]
[*]Works with modded NPCs (Stardew Valley Expanded, Ridgeside Village, etc.)[/*]
[*]Configurable via Generic Mod Config Menu or config.json[/*]
[/list][line]

[size=3][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley[/b] 1.6 or later[/*]
[*][b]SMAPI[/b] 4.0 or later - [url=https://smapi.io]download here[/url][/*]
[/list][line]

[size=3][b]How to Use[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI if you haven't already[/*]
[*]Drop the mod folder into your [font=Courier]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/font] directory[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI[/*]
[*]Press [b]L[/b] (configurable) to open the dialogue log at any time[/*]
[*]Click an NPC's name at the top to filter to just their conversations[/*]
[/list][line]

[size=3][b]Configuration[/b][/size]

A [font=Courier]config.json[/font] is created on first launch inside the mod folder. You can also configure in-game if you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] installed.

[list]
[*][b]OpenLogKey[/b] (default: L) - Key to open the log[/*]
[*][b]MaxEntries[/b] (default: 200) - Maximum entries kept (up to 1000)[/*]
[*][b]LogNarratorDialogue[/b] (default: false) - Also log dialogue with no NPC speaker[/*]
[*][b]ShowDateInLog[/b] (default: true) - Show the in-game date next to each entry[/*]
[/list][line]

[size=3][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Works with [b]Stardew Valley Expanded[/b] and other NPC expansion mods[/*]
[*]Works with [b]Canon-Friendly Dialogue Expansion[/b] and other dialogue mods[/*]
[*]Multiplayer compatible - each player logs their own dialogue[/*]
[*]Split-screen compatible[/*]
[*]No known mod conflicts[/*]
[/list][line]

[size=3][b]Notes[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]In multiplayer, each farmhand only sees dialogue shown to them - this is by design[/*]
[*]Quest dialogue and letters are not logged in this version[/*]
[/list][line]

[size=3][b]Source Code[/b][/size]

This mod is open source. Check the source on [url=https://github.com/JoinFreeMe]GitHub[/url].
